# User shell command table

The 58-command table of the stock user shell (Tsk_USHL).

**Category:** table · **Address:** `0x601fbe38` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md)

Commands include take, iseq, fcs, dbg, ui and wifi. Some write flash or settings: never run flash or prm writes.
